item.title: Intelligence Without Action Is Just Overhead with Patrick McGarry
item.description: Patrick McGarry, Federal CDO at ServiceNow and author of The Adaptive Organization, has spent years watching organizations accumulate data and tools but fail to convert them into decisions. Patrick joins Juan and Tim to walk through why federal data programs stall.

item.title: TAKEAWAY Intelligence Without Action Is Just Overhead with Patrick McGarry
item.description: This is the takeaway episode with Patrick McGarry, Federal CDO at ServiceNow.

item.title: Data Products Done Right: Lessons from Capital One's Journey at Scale with Bethany Sehon
item.description: Bethany Sehon, Enterprise Data Leader at Capital One, has been building data products and ontologies in production long before they became buzzwords.

item.title: TAKEAWAY - Data Products Done Right: Lessons from Capital One's Journey at Scale with Bethany Sehon
item.description: This is the takeaway episode with Bethany Sehon, Enterprise Data Leader at Capital One.

item.title: Honest No-BS Data Podcast 7th Year and Season 12 Kick Off
item.description: This is the start of our 7th year of doing the podcast. Juan and Tim kick off the 12th season.

item.title: Takeaways from Gartner Data & Analytics Rants with Sanjeev Mohan, Ryan Dolley, Juan and Tim
item.description: This was an impromptu recording where Sanjeev Mohan and Ryan Dolley join Juan and Tim to share what they learned.

item.title: Think Like a Librarian: Why the Reference Interview Is the Framework Data Teams Are Missing with Jenna Jordan and Amalia Child
item.description: Juan and Tim sit down with data librarians Jenna Jordan and Amalia Child to explore why library science may be the missing lens for data work.

item.title: Season 11 Premiere: What happened in 2025 and where are we going in 2026
item.description: In the opening episode of 2026, Juan and Tim discuss what happened in the data world during 2025. We discuss semantics, ontologies, context, governance, and of course... AI!

item.title: Building AI Agents with Lena Hall
item.description: Tim and Juan chat with Lena Hall, the Senior Director of Developer Relations at Akamai, and an AI practitioner where we dive into what it means to build AI agents.

item.title: TAKEAWAYS - What is Data + AI Observability and Why It's Part of Your Competitive Moat with Barr Moses
item.description: Barr Moses, CEO & Co-Founder of Monte Carlo, challenges the notion that models alone create competitive advantage.
